name: DoKomi
blurb: Germany's largest anime, manga and Japanese-culture expo in Düsseldorf, with an Artist Alley, cosplay, music acts and voice-actor guests.

editions.evidence: Homepage countdown banner: 'Next 9 - 11.7.2027'; confirmed via /en/event/when-and-where: '09.-11. July 2027' at Messe Düsseldorf, Stockumer Kirchstrasse 61, 40474 Duesseldorf.

notes: Next confirmed edition is 9-11 July 2027. The site's /en/guests/all page (linked from the homepage 'Guests' teaser) is still headed 'Guests 2026' internally and lists last edition's roster (ALI, nano, STEREO DIVE FOUNDATION, ZERA, AiM, Sakura Kurihara and ~30 more music/DJ/mangaka/voice-actor guests plus 'Badbrix' and 'Bartosz Sztybor' tagged 'Industry'); since this is not yet the 2027 lineup, guests is recorded as none-yet per the research rules rather than picking that roster.
